class.name: CgameRollbackDebugger
class.brief_description: Debug view over a [CgameRollbackNetcode] that records rollbacks, prediction misses and desyncs.
class.description: [CgameRollbackDebugger] records every rollback (from and to frame, number of resimulated frames, the player whose late input caused it), the per-player prediction miss rate, desync frames together with a state diff, and can produce a text report. Drive the netcode through this wrapper ([method add_remote_input], [method advance], [method process]) so that inputs can be classified; the netcode itself is not modified.

method.name: add_remote_input
method.description: Forwards to [method CgameRollbackNetcode.add_remote_input] and classifies the input: it counts as late when the frame was already simulated, and as a misprediction when it differed from the input that was used. The player that causes a rollback is remembered as its cause.

method.name: advance
method.description: Calls [method CgameRollbackNetcode.advance], records the resulting state in a bounded history and records any rollback that happened.

method.name: attach
method.description: Attaches the debugger to [param net] and starts listening to its [signal CgameRollbackNetcode.desync_detected] signal.

method.name: attach_remote_state
method.description: Provides the remote peer's state for a desync at [param frame] and returns the sorted key paths at which it differs from the local state (see [method diff_states]). The diff is stored in the desync record.

method.name: diff_states
method.description: Returns the sorted key paths (for example [code]"players.1.x"[/code] or [code]"items[2]"[/code]) at which [param a] and [param b] differ.

method.name: miss_rate
method.description: Returns mispredicted inputs divided by late inputs of [param player_id], or [code]0.0[/code] if none arrived late.

method.name: process
method.description: Calls [method CgameRollbackNetcode.process] and records any rollback that happened.

method.name: report
method.description: Returns a multi-line text report with frame counters, rollbacks, per-player miss rates and desyncs.

method.name: state_history
method.description: Returns the state recorded when [param frame] was reached (it may be mispredicted if a rollback followed), or an empty dictionary.

members.member: Desync records [code]{frame, local_checksum, remote_checksum, local_state, diff}[/code].
Per player, the number of remote inputs that arrived for an already simulated frame.
Per player, the number of late inputs that differed from the prediction.
